items.title: OpenAI hires Uber President Jill Hazelbaker to lead communications, filling a critical role that was curiously vacant for 10 months

items.title: OpenAI Adds Another Big Name As Uber Loses Longtime Executive
items.summary: OpenAI has named Jill Hazelbaker as its chief corporate affairs officer, putting her in charge of the organization’s worldwide communications strategy. Hazelbaker will partner with teams across OpenAI to expand public understanding of AI and reinforce trust, the company stated...

items.title: Uber president Jill Hazelbaker joins OpenAI as communications chief
items.summary: Investing.com -- Uber Technologies Inc. announced Tuesday that President Jill Hazelbaker will leave the ride-hailing company to become chief corporate affairs officer at OpenAI, where she will oversee global communications and corporate positioning efforts.
